description: Create a cited research decision memo from public sources. Accepts a research question plus an optional company, domain, time window, and depth. Returns an executive answer, 5 to 8 cited public source URLs, a claim/evidence matrix, conflicting evidence, confidence levels, risks and unknowns, and three next research actions as JSON and Markdown. For business, technical, and general public research. Refuses private-person dossiers, fabricated citations, restricted scraping, trading signals, and automated medical, legal, financial, employment, or insurance decisions. Price: $0.99 USDC. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired tool result and does not run the tool. Payment is verified and settled before the tool runs.

depth.description: Optional retrieval depth. Defaults to standard.

domain.description: Optional public company domain or website.

question.description: Public business, technical, or general research question.

time_window.description: Optional evidence window. Defaults to year.

name: cited_research_brief
